facts.function: parts of electric fuel pumps (capacitor, valve plate, valve seat, valve body, protective cap)

gri_path: Section XVI note 2(a): a capacitor is a good of heading 8532 and goes there, not to pump parts 8413.91
GRI 6: capacitor subheading depends on capacitor type

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of pumps, applies to valve plate, seat, body, cap but not to the capacitor, which falls under 8532

missing_facts: What type of capacitor is it (aluminum or tantalum electrolytic, ceramic, film, variable)? The 6-digit subheading depends on it.
What material are the valve plate, valve seat, valve body and cap made of, and are they dedicated to the fuel pump?
classify separately: valve plate, valve seat, valve body, protective cap
classification.rationale: Several different parts are named. The first, the capacitor, is classified in 8532 by Section XVI note 2(a), and its 6-digit subheading cannot be chosen without the capacitor type.
